detail.title: CP-UNC-BE51E-VMD-Q
features: Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264B, H.264H, MJPEG
WDR (120 dB), Day/Night (ICR), 3D NR, ROI, Defog, AWB, AGC, BLC, HLC

General.Minimum Illumination: 0.001 lux@F1.4 (Color, 30 IRE), 0.0001 lux@F1.4 (B/W, 30 IRE), 0 lux (IR on)
General.White Balance: Auto/ Natural/ Street Lamp/ Outdoor/ Manual
General.Video Compression: Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264B, H.264H, MJPEG (only supported by sub stream)
General.Frame Rate: Main stream: 5MP (2960 × 1668)@1–25/30 fps, 1080p (1920 × 1080)@50/60 fps Sub stream 1: D1 (704 × 576/704 × 480)@1–25/30 fps Sub stream 2: 720p (1280 × 720)@1–25/30 fps Sub stream 3: D1 (704 × 576/704 × 480)@1fps *The values above are the max. frame rates of each stream, for multiple streams, the values will be subjected to the total encoding capacity
General.Overlay: Privacy Masking, Channel Title, Time Title, Location, Custom Title, Face Statistics
General.Bit Rate: H.265: 3 kbps–6144 kbps, H.264: 3 kbps–6144 kbps
General.Alarm IN: 2 Channels in: wet contact, 5 mA 3–5 VDC
General.Alarm Out: 2 Channels out: dry contact, 1,000 mA 30 VDC/500 mA 50 VAC
General.Protocol: IPv4, IPv6, HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, UDP, RTP, RTSP, RTCP, RTMP, SMTP V3, SFTP, DHCP, DNS, QoS, UPnP, NTP, Multicast, ICMP, IGMP, NAS, PPPoE, SNMP, Auto Connect, TLS v1.2 and v1.3, InstaOn
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Intrusion, Tripwire, Abandon Object, Crowd gathering, Missing Object, Loitering Detection, IMD (support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human)
General.People Counting: Tripwire people counting, Generating and exporting report (Day/Week/Month/year), People counting in area and queue management, Generating and exporting report (Day/Week/ Month), 4 rules can be set for tripwire, people counting in area and queue management.
General.Face Detection: Face detection, Target Box Overlay, Remove Duplicate Faces, Face Cutout (Face/ One Inch Photo/ Custom), Snapshot Mode (Real- Time/ Optimized/ Quality Priority), Optimal face snapshot upload, Face attributes extraction including 6 attributes and 8 expressions, Snapshot strategies (real-time snapshot, quality priority and optimization snapshot), Face angle filter, Optimized Duration, Quality Threshold, Snapshot Sensitivity
General.Alarm Event: No SD card, SD card full, SD card error, Network disconnection, IP conflict, Motion detection, Video tampering, Tripwire, Intrusion, Abandoned object, Missing object, Loitering detection, Crowd gathering, Scene changing, Audio detection, Voltage detection, External alarm, Face detection, IMD, People counting in area, Stay detection, People counting, Abnormal Number of People, Queue people number alarm, Queue time alarm, Security exception, Defocus detection
General.Cyber Security: AES 256-bit Encryption, Configuration encryption, Trusted execution, Digest, Security logs, WSSE, Account lockout, Syslog, Video encryption, 802.1x, Allow list/Block list, HTTPS, Trusted upgrade, Trusted boot, Firmware encryption
General.Power Out: 12 VDC power output, max. current 165 mA,  peak current 700 mA
General.Storage: SFTP, NAS, Mirco SD card (Max. 512 GB)
General.Certificates: ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 20000-1 : 2018, CE, FCC and RoHS, BIS, STQC approved compliance report
